notes.title: First Week is Full of Updates! (Patch Notes)
notes.content:
First of all, a[b] BIG THANK YOU to everyone who has submitted bugs to us!!![/b] You guys are awesome and helping us make Rain on Your Parade the best game it could be!

We definitely stayed busy fixing and tweaking as much as we could. You might have not noticed, but we've actually been update the Steam build [i]every night![/i] I think this is the first night when we're actually not pushing a new update (hopefully a good sign we fixed everything?) 

[h2]Here's the Patch Notes:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Re-designed the penultimate Seattle Defense level to speed it up and make it less tedious to re-play
[*] Fixed an exploit where you could unlock some achievements without actually doing the things you need to do (sorry!)
[*] Clarified some objective names and added hints to make some levels less confusing
[*] Improved face drawing smoothing when brush size is smol
[*] Added nicer background to Cardboard Gear Cloud (since so many of you enjoyed taking photos there!)
[*] A few quality-of-life and difficulty tweaks (like guards on Cardboard Gear Cloud having slightly shorter sight distance)
[*] Fixed a bunch of places where you could clip out of the world (particularly the Cloudbuster Canyon)
[*] Added "Join our Newsletter" button to main menu like the shameless self-promoting clouds we are
[*] Replaced some older decors with brand new, flashier ones!
[*] Fixed a bug in Weatherman Goes to Work that could cause cars not to appear
[*] Fixed missing collisions on some objects
[*] Bunch of other minor fixes we forgot!
[/list]

[i](if you're playing on consoles, don't worry - you got all the critical updates already, and anything left is coming soon as well!)[/i]

[h2]What's Next? YOU Tell us![/h2]

We're exploring our options, but we'd really LOVE to hear from you! We got a little 2-minute survey going: 

https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSfdtT2vSy87exV4nXeriGI3bD7bv1PVaThyH5td2ldDI_S0Qw/viewform

We'd appreciate your feedback!

[h2]Help us Spread the Word[/h2]

If you enjoyed the game, you'd be doing us a big help if you'd mention it to your favorite streamers and Youtubers :) We've been sending tons of emails (SO MANY EMAILS) but at the end of the day, nothing works better than some good old word-of-mouth! And who wouldn't believe such amazing folks as yourselves ;D 


Anyway, that's it for the current update! More to come, I am sure, as well as new goodies and content like merch or DLC :O 

Cheers,
Jakub
Lead Dev 
On Behalf of Unbound Creations Team

notes.title: Big Demo Update: polish, new character, AND potato mode!
notes.content:
Hi Everyone!

First of all, thank you for following the game thus far :) We're doing really well on development and hitting all our milestones! We're already looking at the weather calendar for next year to find the rainiest day possible.

While working on the main game, we're doing a lot of polish and tweaks on existing elements, so it makes sense to update the demo as well!

notes.title: How to make a Cloudy Pumpkin for Halloween
notes.content:
Here at Unbound Creations, we believe in the Cult of the Cloud, so naturally we spent our weekend carving an offering - The Pumpkin Cloud! And you, too, can carve one - for a mere $10 or less! Here's our recipe (WITHOUT 5 pages of personal life stories, what a treat).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36590961/b0832d938fb0e89ddbdabfb2c6f211c341b4eee2.jpg[/img]

[h2][u][b]What you'll need[/b][/u][/h2]
[list]
[*] Pumpkin
[*] X-Acto Knife or Regular Knife
[*] Spoon
[*] One Marker Boi
[*] Candle
[*] Some household cleaner + rag/sponge
[*] OPTIONAL: a really cool significant other to do all the carving for you while you show them your favorite K-Pop tracks
[/list]

[h2][u][b]The Recipe[/b][/u][/h2]

[h3]1. Go into a field and find yourself a nice Pumpkin[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36590961/d2141a5bf807ab2857fa566fabd453335ee1ef70.jpg[/img]

[h3]2. Use KNIFE to cut the Pumpkin's top off, and pull it out![/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36590961/cac23181ff8536704786c5624660da5fb8044913.gif[/img]

[h3]3. Use SPOON to scrape all the inside gooey bits. [/h3]
(PRO TIP: You can separate the seeds and dry + roast them in the oven for some yummy snack! But don't eat too much at once...)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36590961/d0e1aaa63f4a24f2e2d1565af9805755bfeffdbf.jpg[/img]

[h3]4. Use MARKER to draw your design. Don't worry, you can cheat by printing it out and tracing it! Nobody will know, not even Mom![/h3]
(Here's a Link to the [url=https://pbs.twimg.com/profile_images/1316954034800979969/WTLc50Zb_400x400.jpg]Official Cloudy Image[/url]©℗®™ for reference)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36590961/f9321ed29e54314b6e0fd1ac5bba1d9ee83c0e94.jpg[/img]

[h3]5. Now comes the tricky bit. Use KNIFE to scrape out the insides of all the shapes, leaving the outlines sticking out. You want to cut fairly deep to make the Pumpkin thin enough to see light thru, but not completely see-through. [/h3]
PRO TIP: We didn't have an X-Acto Knife, but my regular Knife had a slightly bent tip due to [REDACTED]. The bent tip actually made it easier to peel off and scrape pieces. 

When you are done you should have something like this:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36590961/606930c0bc509bb6a53232df501363f6908cc31b.jpg[/img]

[h3]6. Use a wipe or cleaning detergent to rub off the remaining marker [/h3]

[h3]7. OPTIONAL: You can also use KNIFE to cut out the back, which will make it easier to insert candle.[/h3]

[h3]8: Insert lit CANDLE and turn off the lights....[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36590961/b0832d938fb0e89ddbdabfb2c6f211c341b4eee2.jpg[/img]

[h3]SPOOPY!!![/h3]

Now go find a nice home for Cloudy Pumpkin, perhaps your porch, perhaps your bathtub, we're not here to tell you how to live your life, go wild and rain your heart's out!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36590961/b0d4a208b763a3c6c071fcd78a12dafad7810479.jpg[/img]

[i]p.s. Many of you have asked - Jakub, why do you capitalize Pumpkin? My answer: yes[/i]
